scope: Preparation only for three fresh CPU Debug negative-entry probes, cloning the prepared actual HG=.1 smoke runtime and identical initial BI4/normals. No solver, build, reader, GenCase, Git, GPU program or production/formal input mutation is part of this script.

planned_cases.reason: Model1 and positive Ck=.1 are a valid conductivity-law configuration; expected failure is the shared HG constant-k scope guard, not an invalid-Ck parser error.
planned_cases.expected_error_substring: Experimental dynamic HG is CPU-only in the constant-k X-periodic loaded column, without time-dependent viscosity; actual FreeSlip bottom geometry is checked after loading particles.

planned_cases.added_parameter_only: ViscoTime with value upl_hg_column_reject_visco_r1.dat, relative to the runtime XML directory
planned_cases.reason: JDsViscoInput::LoadFile reads two numeric time/value columns and requires at least two rows. The initial viscosity is0 and a later value is nonzero; the ViscoTime object itself must trigger the shared HG guard before stepping.
planned_cases.expected_error_substring: Experimental dynamic HG is CPU-only in the constant-k X-periodic loaded column, without time-dependent viscosity; actual FreeSlip bottom geometry is checked after loading particles.

planned_cases.reason: JSphCfgRun MDBC_NOSLIP sets TBoundary2/SlipMode2; JSph::LoadConfigCommands applies NoSlip, overriding the XML consistently. The unchanged InitDynamicPoreWallCpu loop must reject the actual native wall SlipMode before stepping.
planned_cases.expected_error_substring: Dynamic wall fixture requires finite stationary FreeSlip wall normals.

planned_fresh_paths.overwrite_policy: Reject every existing seed, manifest, configuration, future solve output or future log label. Create no solver-output directory or solve log during preparation.

proof_and_bindings: Pin and rehash the current manifest, select exactly one smoke variant and verify its configuration/runtime/BI4/normals identities; copy only these shallow entries, not nested retained-control receipt trees.

Change existing XML value attributes by unique byte edits; preserve all other bytes, including the HG ON comment. Insert the sole new ViscoTime parameter after the original Visco line with the same indentation and newline style.
Reverse the declared edits to prove byte-identical original runtime and independently reverse attributes/remove the sole new parameter to prove the same comment-preserving DOM.
Leave HG=.1, eta=.02, initial scalar Visco0, clocks, material, loading/drainage, particle fields and normals unchanged except the declared negative-case value attributes/new parameter.
Record current parser/guard source hashes and reverify all source inputs at preparation completion. Root separately binds them to the actual Debug program used for each later call.
Declare expected_error_substring, exact future argv, before-stepping expectation and forbidden data/Part_0001.bi4 for each job; preparation does not observe those results.
later_root_owner_requirements: For each separate actual DebugCPU project-main call, capture the immediate typed exit code, expected exact guard error, absence of Part_0001 and any later PART, no advanced steps/HG force activity, and unchanged input/source/program/runtime bindings. A parser/file/CLI error, a different guard, successful stepping or a bare nonzero exit is not a passed rejection. Do not run a GPU probe against the frozen independent GPU program.
